about: Punctuation by convention: what the designers of well-spaced Google Fonts families do with each punctuation mark, on top of Kinetikern2's spacing. Each side moves by c + m·s/50 + r·ρ/50 units per 1000 em, where s is the side's own sidebearing as the model sets it and ρ the font's letter rhythm (the median sidebearing of its lowercase), by the conventions of text, display and handwriting faces; and each side keeps its share of the kerning its shapes suggest (kern: left, right), a pair the product of its two facing sides', every other mark kern_scale per side. marks: each mark's characters; aliases: a mark too few families have takes its twin's conventions. Learned from Spacing QA's measurements.
